title: Precedent store loader has the same uncaught commonpath failure mode

finding.claim: Precedent store loader has the same uncaught commonpath failure mode
finding.evidence: This path validation repeats the same 'commonpath' pattern, so a precedent store path on a different drive/root can raise ValueError instead of producing the intended validation error.
finding.recommendation: Handle ValueError around commonpath here as well and treat it as an invalid outside-repository path.

probe.summary: Same executed check as packet G4 (`probes/gap_commonpath_probe.py`, result `gap-commonpath-pair.txt`), precedent-loader half: - `_load_precedents` against an outside-repo path at HEAD produces the intended validation error ("precedent store …: resolves outside the repository"), not a raw commonpath traceback. - `_is_within` fails closed under a simulated cross-drive ValueError (monkeypatched `commonpath`; real Windows drives cannot exist on this Linux host — the POSIX mixed-path case raises the same exception from the same call and is shown directly in the probe output). - Git: the unguarded pattern existed at `4e5cbd8^` in both loaders and was replaced by the shared helper in `4e5cbd8` (v0.9.6), whose docstring cites this finding by ID. The v15 record's head (e3fc6a8) is an ancestor of the fix — the claim was true of the code it reviewed. Authority note: this item is tagged authority-affecting (precedent/decision validity) because the precedent store feeds standing classifications; the defect itself was a load-time error path, since fixed.
